content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early-to-mid forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Overestimates prices in late forecast horizon (last 5–10 days) following sharp upward moves.
- Shows persistent lag in capturing true price momentum; forecasts lag behind actual price turns by 2–5 days.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp price spikes, then gradually corrects downward — model overreacts to volatility.
- Mean reversion bias: model assumes prices return to prior mean too quickly, underestimating sustained upward trends.
- Forecasts are overly conservative in high-volatility periods, failing to capture extreme price movements.
- Model exhibits “sticky” behavior — fails to adjust forecast mid-horizon when true price deviates significantly from initial trend.
